name: Occultist's kit
body:
Source Occult Adventures pg. 249
Price 45 gp; Weight 32-1/2 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit includes a backpack, a bedroll, a belt pouch, chalk (10 pieces), flint and steel, ink (1 ounce), an inkpen, an iron pot, a journalUE, occultist’s implements (2), torches (10), trail rations (5 days), and a waterskin.
